reviewer: assistant visual inspection of the original supplied video frames
scope: Diagnostic cases selected during review. These are not dense ground-truth masks or an unbiased recall sample; a covered probe does not prove complete coverage.
presence_scope: Coarse manually reviewed boxes for the principal on-screen appearances only. Background passersby are not fully annotated. IoU>=0.3 is a matching diagnostic, not COCO AP; unmatched positive-scene detections are not assumed false positives.

presence_cases.description: One principal close presenter; face visible.

One small on-screen person in the camera display; physical body absent. Classification must abstain at this face size.
One principal side/rear presenter. Small background passers not annotated.
One principal rear-view presenter with invisible face. Small background passers not annotated.
Partial torso, legs and hand; no face.
Architecture in three edited panels; no visible humans.
Three on-screen appearances of the same presenter in edited panels.

cases.description: Occluded face, close foreground hands, red/gray shirt. All visible body parts belong to the presenter.
